Maps the e-mail a person uses in the chatbot (key) to the e-mail that person has on their Notion account (value), so 'Ingediend door' resolves to the right Notion user. Keys and values are matched case-insensitively. Entries whose key starts with '_' are ignored (they are docs/examples).
